source.note: Transcribed from the d10SRD Conformance section. This file is a pinned copy of an external authority, not a second authority. When d10SRD publishes a new rules_id or srd_version, this file must be re-pinned and the conformance test re-read; the test asserts the pin is intact so a silent drift becomes a build failure.

srd_controls: the check equation and its integer domains
authority_boundary.quote: This is difficulty/check scaling. Do not divide health, damage, movement, range, time, capacity, currency, ammunition, action counts, or unrelated economies unless a named module explicitly says so.
authority_boundary.consequence: Authored balance numbers -- weapon damage, movement costs, block reduction, unit HP -- are NOT d10SRD conformance surface. Pinning them under a conformance label makes a legitimate balance change read as a rules violation. They belong in a balance-baseline test instead.

vectors.requirement: reproduce the published ability table, including 4-5 => -2
vectors.reason: The Godot port implements no ability-score check resolution. Verified by absence: no check-resolution symbol may appear in the port's configuration authority.
The Godot port implements no difficulty class. Verified by absence.

vectors.requirement: require a 6+ confirmation for natural 1 and natural 10 threats
vectors.reason: The Godot port implements no threat confirmation. Verified by absence.
Godot 'skills' are equipment and capability tags, not ranked check inputs. Verified by absence of a rank field.

vectors.requirement: keep the tactical AP maximum at 10
keep setting and transport authority outside this core
vectors.reason: Governance constraint on the SRD, not a value the port can assert. The port satisfies it by consuming the SRD rather than redefining it -- which is what pinning this file is for.

forbidden_symbols_note: If any of these appear in the Godot configuration authority, the port has begun implementing check resolution and vectors 1-4 stop being not-applicable. The conformance test fails closed on their presence so the 'not applicable' declarations above can never quietly become false.
